initial_execution.cause: Fixture expectations used ValueError/FileNotFoundError, while the frozen readers correctly raised GenerationError for missing receipt and AuditError for symlinks. Corrected fixture exception types; no source or production changes were needed for these failures.

production_review_findings_resolved: Evaluation scene order must use the fixed 60-scene full-manifest subset, not the 100-row cohort.
Resource-limited metrics must retain NULL and report checked/skipped counts instead of unconditional full-verification claims.
Prior stage receipts must bind stage number and exact 1/10/60 building scope.
Independent verification includes all displacement metrics.
Accumulation of prior receipt hashes must not be shadowed by the stage result dictionary.
